gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.072332 42.453627)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 240 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH target_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-89.072332, 42.453627), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(rast, 1, ST_Buffer(target_point.geom::geometry, 10000, 'quad_segs=8')) AS clipped_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us,
    target_point
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Buffer(target_point.geom::geometry, 10000, 'quad_segs=8'))
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(clipped_rast, 1)).*,
    ST_Distance(target_point.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_Point(x, y), 4326)::geography) AS distance_meters
  FROM
    dem_clip,
    target_point
),
nearest_below_240 AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(distance_meters) AS nearest_distance
  FROM
    elevation_analysis
  WHERE
    val < 240
)
SELECT
  nearest_distance
FROM
  nearest_below_240;
